fact: A 12 November 2021 technical specification says works to turn a room in the National Assembly building into a data centre were only partly completed, with cooling, fire suppression, electrical, access control and CCTV still to be procured.
title: Assembleia Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe: Novo Centro de Dados
publisher: Assembleia Nacional de São Tomé e Príncipe (UNDP procurement notice)
